howto.title: How to use WinTools
howto.intro: WinTools lives next to File Explorer. There is nothing to open: you use it while you drag files.
howto.step1.text: Start dragging one or more files or a folder in File Explorer, and keep holding the mouse button.
howto.step2.text: While you hold the files, press the trigger key once.
howto.step3.text: The WinTools wheel opens around the pointer. Move toward a group, then toward the command you want.
howto.step4.text: Let go on the command. WinTools does the work in the background and tells you when it is done. Your original is never changed.
howto.convert.text: Change the format: a photo to PNG or WebP, subtitles to VTT, a document to text.
howto.tools.text: Change the file itself: compress, resize, rotate, protect, repair, test.
howto.actions.text: Do something with the file: copy its path or name, rename a batch, add to ZIP, see its information.
howto.keys.text: Esc closes the wheel without doing anything. Releasing outside the wheel does nothing either.
howto.only: The wheel shows only what fits the files you drag: an image gets image commands, a PDF gets PDF commands.
features.title: Features
features.intro: Everything WinTools can do now. The wheel shows only what fits the files you drag.
about.title: About WinTools
about.text: A file utility for Windows: drag files, press a key, choose what to do. Everything runs on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
about.safe: Your originals are never changed: every result is a new file, and a name that is taken is never overwritten.
onboard.welcome.text: A quick tour, then two or three choices, and you are ready.
onboard.language.text: Choose the language of WinTools. You can change it later in Settings.
onboard.trigger.text: The key you press while dragging files to open the wheel.
onboard.startup.text: Start WinTools when you sign in, so it is always ready.
onboard.ready.text: Drag a file in File Explorer and press {0}.
settings.title: Settings
settings.saved: Changes are saved and applied at once.
settings.savedNow: Saved. A running WinTools applies it at once.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the settings file. Check that its folder can be written to.
settings.closeUnsaved: Your last change could not be saved. Close again to discard it, or try again later.
settings.readOnly: These settings cannot be changed here: the settings file was written by a newer version of WinTools, or it cannot be read. Nothing will be overwritten.
settings.language.hint: The language of the window, the wheel and the messages.
settings.trigger.hint: While dragging files, press this key to open the wheel.
settings.trigger.why: Only keys that are harmless if they reach Explorer after the drop are offered.
settings.sounds.hint: Soft ticks while you move through the wheel, and a sound when a job ends.
settings.startup.hint: Start WinTools when you sign in, for this Windows account only.
settings.startup.other: Another copy of WinTools starts with Windows now. Turn this on to start this copy instead.
settings.startup.missing: Not available: WinTools.Host.exe is not next to this window's program.
settings.startup.failed: Start with Windows could not be changed (the registry refused).
settings.startup.on: WinTools will start when you sign in.
settings.startup.off: WinTools will not start when you sign in.
settings.output.hint: Originals are never changed. A new name is chosen when a file already exists.
settings.output.choose: Choose where WinTools saves new files
settings.output.bad: This folder cannot be used (it must be a full local or network path). New files go next to the originals.
settings.quality.hint: Used by Convert to JPEG and Convert to WebP. Compress has its own levels.
settings.resize: Custom size in the Resize menu
settings.resize.hint: Fit inside this box. Leave a side at 0 to let it follow the other.
settings.resize.none: With both sides at 0 the Resize menu has no custom size.
settings.theme.hint: This version has the dark theme only.
settings.animations.hint: Short movements when the wheel opens and changes.
settings.animations.hintOff: Short movements when the wheel opens and changes. Animation effects are off in Windows now, so Follow Windows shows none.
